verdict.rationale: Docs claim Yapily provides an OpenAPI v3 spec used to generate client libraries (yapily-docs-22, yapily-docs-8), but a direct probe for the OpenAPI file at all standard candidate paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, etc.) returned 404 (yapily-probe-2), so the machine-readable spec is not verifiably downloadable as claimed. missing for 10: a working, discoverable URL for the OpenAPI file itself, independent confirmation of successful download/parsing.
